info.summary: Backend-for-frontend API surface for the ZorEWS Early Warning System (banking + insurance verticals).
info.description:
Auto-discovered from `services/bff/src/server.ts`. Covers every public `/v1/*` operation plus the SPA-internal `/api/*` proxies. Generated by `scripts/gen-openapi.js`.

See Banking API Integration §6 (envelope), §7 (OAuth), §11 (error shape) for protocol details.

post.description:
{ header: { status: 'SUCCESS', code, message, requestId, timestamp }, body: ScoreResponse }
Response envelope (error, §11 shape):
{ header: { status: 'FAILURE', requestId, timestamp }, error: { code, message, severity } }
Tenant context (X-Tenant-ID + X-Channel) is enforced via the
requireTenant middleware before this handler runs.
Legacy callers that POST a bare body (no envelope) are still served:
the handler peels `body.body` if present, otherwise treats the whole

Returns the secret_base32 + otpauth:// URL — the client renders
the URL as a QR code so the user can scan it. The user must then
call /auth/2fa/verify with the first code from their authenticator
to complete enrolment; a pending secret expires in 10 minutes.

row and returns a fresh secret. Already-enrolled users get 409
(must call /auth/2fa/disable first to re-enrol).
